grounding.states: Lima is the capital of Peru
grounding.from: Lima is the capital of Peru.

grounding.states: Cusco is the Inca capital in modern Peru, not the current national capital
grounding.from: It is the Inca capital in modern Peru. It is not the current national capital.

value.answer: Lima. People sometimes mix it up with Cusco, but Cusco was the Inca capital and isn't the current one.
